language.note: The constitution also recognizes over 40 indigenous languages as official for use by their own peoples

terrainDescription.zh: 中部為亞諾斯大草原，安地斯山脈支脈延伸至西北部，南部與東南部進入亞馬遜/奧里諾科雨林區，北部則有加勒比海岸線。
terrainDescription.en: The Llanos savanna dominates the center, an Andean spur extends into the northwest, the south/southeast reaches into Amazon/Orinoco rainforest, and a Caribbean coastline runs along the north.

historicalContext.zh: 西班牙語為官方語言，憲法承認逾40種原住民語言在其族群範圍內具官方地位；道路標誌系統採用《委內瑞拉交通管制統一裝置手冊》，明確以美國 MUTCD 為藍本。
historicalContext.en: Spanish is the official language; the constitution recognizes over 40 indigenous languages as official for use by their own peoples. The road-sign system is governed by a manual explicitly modeled on the US MUTCD.
